title: Works for my needs.
text:
Works for my needs.. I bought both sizes of this product. I am not going to lie but actually state they both are made of flimsy side paneling. I am sure partly to help keep them foldable and that is partly what Iike about them.
They do hold up my chubby legs just fine and my 28 lb dog sits and climbs on it just fine but in reality, a child or an adult shouldn't sit on these unless you reinforce them with some sort of stabilization.

Oh the packaging these came in could have been much better.
